variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: .17 HMR
variants.info:
Converts your R-10/22 rifle to fire .17 HMR, providing excellent velocity and long-range headshot performance. This conversion kit also comes with a modified charging handle that makes the gun manually operated, acting as a straight-pull bolt action!

Animation likely completely broken, WIP.

variants.name: .22 Win. Magnum
variants.info: Loads your .22LR rifle with higher-power magnum rounds, improving performance against the body while reducing it against the head.
